verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managed payout schedules that can be applied to balance accounts, custom payouts that give full control over timing, and CashOut for instant access to funds. The per-seller balance-account model supports configuring schedules per seller. However, the evidence never names specific daily, weekly, or monthly cadences, and instant payouts appear only as one marketing line. Missing for 10: documented daily/weekly/monthly schedule options, explicit instant payouts to cards or real-time rails with coverage limits, explicit per-seller schedule override docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller

citations.quote: you can create a managed payout schedule for your balance platform and apply it to balance accounts with the same location and currency
decide when and how your users are paid, either utilizing our managed payouts solution, or exercising full control over timing with custom payouts
Set custom settlement and payout times. Combine with CashOut to unlock instant access to funds.
Managed payouts allow you to automate fund payouts to users on your balance platform using Adyen's most efficient payout logic.
